# WAS_ProbWeighted { #wass2s.WAS_ProbWeighted }

```python
WAS_ProbWeighted(
    metric='GROC',
    threshold=0.5,
    moderate_break=0.6,
    high_break=0.8,
    moderate_weight=0.6,
    high_weight=0.8,
    top_weight=1.0,
    missing_score='zero',
    normalize_probabilities=True,
)
```

Skill-weighted combination of multi-model tercile probabilities.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                    | Type                   | Description                                                                                                                                   | Default   |
|-------------------------|------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| metric                  | str                    | Skill metric represented by ``scores``. The stepwise transformation is designed for higher-is-better scores bounded approximately by 0 and 1. | `"GROC"`  |
| threshold               | float                  | Scores less than or equal to this value receive zero weight.                                                                                  | `0.5`     |
| moderate_break          | float                  | Upper score boundary of the moderate-skill class.                                                                                             | `0.6`     |
| high_break              | float                  | Upper score boundary of the high-skill class.                                                                                                 | `0.8`     |
| moderate_weight         | float                  | Weight assigned when ``threshold < score <= moderate_break``.                                                                                 | `0.6`     |
| high_weight             | float                  | Weight assigned when ``moderate_break < score <= high_break``.                                                                                | `0.8`     |
| top_weight              | float                  | Weight assigned when ``score > high_break``.                                                                                                  | `1.0`     |
| missing_score           | (zero, one, \'raise\') | Behaviour when no score can be associated with a model. ``"zero"`` excludes it, ``"one"`` assigns full weight, and ``"raise"`` stops.         | `"zero"`  |
| normalize_probabilities | bool                   | Normalize every complete probability vector before and after the MME. This also converts percentage inputs summing to 100 into fractions.     | `True`    |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Expected ensemble dimensions are ``(probability, T, M, Y, X)``. Public
outputs are always ``(probability, T, Y, X)``. A score is always reduced to
``(Y, X)`` before weighting, preventing an accidental ``M`` dimension from
leaking into the result.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [compute](#wass2s.WAS_ProbWeighted.compute) | Compute a skill-weighted MME of tercile probabilities. |
| [transform_score](#wass2s.WAS_ProbWeighted.transform_score) | Convert a GROC-like skill field into stepwise non-negative weights. |

### compute { #wass2s.WAS_ProbWeighted.compute }

```python
WAS_ProbWeighted.compute(
    rainfall,
    hdcst,
    fcst,
    scores,
    threshold=None,
    complete=False,
)
```

Compute a skill-weighted MME of tercile probabilities.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                     | Description                                                                                                                         | Default    |
|-----------|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| rainfall  | xarray.DataArray         | Observation field with dimensions ``(T, Y, X)``. A singleton or multi-valued ``M`` dimension is accepted; the first member is used. | _required_ |
| hdcst     | xarray.DataArray         | Probabilistic model ensembles with dimensions ``(probability, T, M, Y, X)`` in any order.                                           | _required_ |
| fcst      | xarray.DataArray         | Probabilistic model ensembles with dimensions ``(probability, T, M, Y, X)`` in any order.                                           | _required_ |
| scores    | dict or xarray.DataArray | Model skill fields. Every selected score is reduced to ``(Y, X)``.                                                                  | _required_ |
| threshold | float                    | Runtime override of the instance exclusion threshold.                                                                               | `None`     |
| complete  | bool                     | Fill cells with no positively weighted model using the unweighted multi-model probability mean.                                     | `False`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                    | Description                                   |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
|        | hindcast_weighted, forecast_weighted : xarray.DataArray | Arrays ordered as ``(probability, T, Y, X)``. |

### transform_score { #wass2s.WAS_ProbWeighted.transform_score }

```python
WAS_ProbWeighted.transform_score(score_array, threshold=None)
```

Convert a GROC-like skill field into stepwise non-negative weights.
